name: Kyouraku no Yakata
source:
One day hero woke up without memory in a strange building. All the exits are blocked and in order to get out he needs to examine surroundings, contact its inhabitants and gather some sort of keys.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-february-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
有一天，英雄在一座陌生的建筑中醒来，失去了记忆。所有出口都被封锁，为了出去，他需要检查周围环境，联系居民并收集某种钥匙。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-february-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
